title: Less is more: error-distance scaling relation for data-efficient kilometer-scale downscaling of extreme heat
abstract: arXiv:2609.40140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extreme heat is where urban adaptation needs kilometer-scale data the most, but the simulations training a downscaler can cost more than they save, and how much is needed has not been identified. We measured it with CASPER, a U-Net with a structure-preserving loss downscaling 32 km reanalysis to 1 km temperature, humidity and wind, across 24 configurations of one to eight months. Held-out error grows linearly with climatological distance to the training data, RMSE = 0.83 + 2.95 d, explaining 90% of its variance against 7% for volume and predicting unseen months in advance. On held-out extreme summer weeks CASPER preserves the fine-scale structure and cross-variable physics that matched-budget baselines degrade, and matches station observations during documented heat waves to within 1.8 K. translated_title: 少即是多：用于极端高温数据高效公里级降尺度的误差-距离缩放关系
translated_abstract: 极端高温是城市适应最需要公里尺度数据的领域，但用于训练降尺度模型的模拟成本可能超过其所能节省的成本，且究竟需要多少数据尚未明确。我们通过CASPER对此进行了量化，CASPER是一个采用结构保持损失函数的U-Net网络，可将32公里的再分析数据降尺度到1公里的温度、湿度和风速，共测试了从一个月到八个月的24种配置。结果表明，留出误差随训练数据的气候学距离线性增长，RMSE = 0.83 + 2.95 d，解释了90%的误差方差，而数据量仅能解释7%，且该关系可提前预测未见月份的误差。在留出的极端夏季周上，CASPER保持了精细尺度结构和跨变量物理一致性，而同预算的基线模型则会出现退化；在记录在案的热浪期间，CASPER与站点观测的误差在1.8 K以内。直接迁移到新区域时误差会在地理上退化；仅需11天的本地模拟就能将温哥华的留出误差从3.8 K降至1.3 K。训练周期越短……
tldr: 提出了留出误差与训练数据气候学距离之间的线性缩放关系（可解释90%的误差方差），证明仅需约一至两个月的模拟数据训练降尺度模型即可实现公里级极端高温的高精度预测，且少量本地模拟即可实现高效的跨区域迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a linear error-distance scaling relation (explaining 90% of variance) showing that kilometer-scale extreme heat downscaling can be achieved with only a few months of training simulations, and that a few days of local simulation enables efficient cross-region transfer.
